title: Ịkpa akwa: peyote, brik, ọkpụkpụ herring na bezels
course_title: Ihe eji achọ mma na ime ihe ịchọ mma

say: Ịkpa akwa: peyote, brik, ọkpụkpụ herring na bezels.
Nke a bụ vidiyo maka Modul 3 nke Advanced Beadwork and Jewelery Ime: akwa bead na-apụ apụ.
Ịkpa akwa bead na-eji agịga na eri eme ihe na-agbanwe agbanwe, otu bead n'otu oge, na-enweghị eriri.

say: Nke a bụ otu ọkachamara na-eme atụmatụ. Ifeoma dị na Onitsha nwere onye na-azụ ahịa nwere nkwojiaka 15.5 cm chọrọ peyote cuff obosara cm 4.

panel.heading: Na-eme atụmatụ cuff peyote nwere ụkpụrụ
items: Swatch 10 beads n'obosara ruru 1.3 cm
Ogidi: 4 ÷ 0.13 = 30.8, ya mere 30 (ọbụlagodi)
Ahịrị maka 16 cm: 16 ÷ 0.08 = 200

say: Ọ na-akpa swatch ule n'obosara 10 n'obosara yana ahịrị 20 ogologo. Ọ tụrụ 1.3 cm n'obosara na 1.6 cm ogologo.

say: Ntụ brik dị ka brik dị na mgbidi. Ị na-ejikọta agịga gị n'okpuru àkwà mmiri eri, obere loops n'etiti beads. Malite n'ahịrị nke ọ bụla na akwa nke abụọ na ahịrị ọ bụla bụ otu bead dị mkpụmkpụ, yabụ triangle na-etolite maka ọla ntị nwere agba.

cards.d: Nko n'okpuru eriri àkwà mmiri, ọ bụghị site na beads. Malite n'ahịrị nke ọ bụla na akwa nke abụọ ka ọ daa n'otu n'otu.
Na-ebuli bead 2 mgbe niile, gbadaa otu kọlụm na elu nke ọzọ. Na-arị elu na njedebe nke agba ọ bụla.
Ọbụna-gụọ ntọala gburugburu, gbalite mgbidi ahụ, wee wepụta obere bead 15/0 iji jide ụgbọ ala ahụ.

say: Herringbone, nke a na-akpọkwa Ndebele stitch, na-eme ogidi ndị dabere na abụọ. Na-eburu bead abụọ mgbe niile, gbadaa otu kọlụm na elu nke ọzọ.
N'ime eriri tubular, gbagoro na njedebe nke gburugburu ọ bụla. Na-enweghị nzọụkwụ-elu, eriri na-agbagharị na njikwa.

cards.d: Nko n'okpuru eriri àkwà mmiri, ọ bụghị site na beads. Malite n'ahịrị nke ọ bụla na akwa nke abụọ ka ọ daa n'otu n'otu.
Na-ebuli bead 2 mgbe niile, gbadaa otu kọlụm na elu nke ọzọ. Na-arị elu na njedebe nke agba ọ bụla.
Ọbụna-gụọ ntọala gburugburu, gbalite mgbidi ahụ, wee wepụta obere bead 15/0 iji jide ụgbọ ala ahụ.

say: Otu bezel nwere eriri na-ejide cabochon n'akụkụ ya. Backstitch a isi gburugburu na ọbụna ọnụ ọgụgụ nke beads, rụọ ọrụ peyote elu mgbidi, wee gbanwee na obere 15/0 beads. Ha dọbara mgbidi ahụ n'elu nkume ahụ.

Na-ebuli bead 2 mgbe niile, gbadaa otu kọlụm na elu nke ọzọ. Na-arị elu na njedebe nke agba ọ bụla.
Ọbụna-gụọ ntọala gburugburu, gbalite mgbidi ahụ, wee wepụta obere bead 15/0 iji jide ụgbọ ala ahụ.

say: Bezels na eriri eriri na-ejikarị gluu nka siri ike, na ọtụtụ nwere ihe mgbaze nwere isi siri ike. Gụọ akara ahụ, jiri obere ego mee ka windo mepee.

items: Gụọ akara ma jiri obere ego mee ihe
Debe windo oghe
Zere mmetụ akpụkpọ ahụ
Mechie tube ahụ, debe ya na ụmụaka
Ka ọ gwọọ maka oge niile ekwuru

say: Zere mmetụ akpụkpọ ahụ, mechie tube ma debe ya n'ebe ụmụaka nọ.

panel.rule: Ka eri buru ibu. Glue na-edobe naanị ihe.

say: Lelee ihe ọ bụla kpara akpa. Jiri ụzọ zigzag zoo njedebe eri, ọ bụghị eriri n'elu.
Mee ọla ntị abụọ n'akụkụ n'akụkụ, n'ihi na ndị ahịa na-achọpụta mgbe otu ọnụ ọnụ dị ogologo.
Debe ogidi ụdọ kwụ ọtọ na nke siri ike. Ma maa jijiji ma pịa bezel ọ bụla. Ụgbọ ala rụrụ arụ bụ usoro eweghachitere.

panel.heading: Tupu ị ere ọrụ kpara akpa
items: Eriri ngwụcha nwere ụzọ zigzag, enweghị eriri elu
Abụọ ọla ntị mere n'akụkụ n'akụkụ, eriri dakọtara
Ogidi eriri kwụ ọtọ, enweghị oghere
Bezel gafere ịma jijiji wee pịa ule

say: Icheta. Na peyote, gafere naanị beads. Na stitch brik, malite na akwa nke abụọ iji belata.
N'ọkpụkpụ azụ azụ, bulie bead abụọ wee gbalite gburugburu ọ bụla. N'ime bezel, jiri otu okirikiri gbara okirikiri, wee were obere beads. Ma mee atụmatụ site na swatch tụrụ atụ.

panel.heading: Cheta
items: Peyote: site na beads elu, ọ dịghị mgbe ọ ga-adaba
Brick: malite na akwa mmiri nke abụọ iji belata
Herringbone: 2 beads, na-arịgo n'akụkụ ọ bụla
Bezel: ọbụlagodi okirikiri okirikiri, yabụ obere beads
Ihe nlegharị anya tụrụ atụ na-enye ọnụ ọgụgụ bead

say: Omume gị maka modul a: atụmatụ peyote swatch na cuff, otu ọla ntị triangle nwere fringed, ihe nlere ọkpụkpụ azụ nwere atụmatụ ụdọ, na otu cabochon nke edobere na bezel bead. Were foto nke ọ bụla n'akụkụ otu onye na-achị achị.
Gaa n'ihu na nkuzi ndị dị n'okpuru.
